1.consolidated_definition: "Miopía" (también llamada miope o sabino): persona que presenta un defecto visual caracterizado por la dificultad para ver objetos lejanos con claridad, mientras que los objetos cercanos se perciben con mayor nitidez.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Myopia (also known as myope or sabino): a person presenting a visual defect characterized by difficulty in seeing distant objects clearly, while nearby objects are perceived with greater clarity.
